name: coding-steve
about: Astro 6 blog (this site). Small. `astro sync` generates the content-collection types first, as `astro check` would.

name: cesium-spatial
about: pnpm monorepo, three library packages checked one after another (its own typecheck script does the same). The core package is built first so h3 and s2 can resolve its types.

name: playwright
about: microsoft/playwright, one of the TypeScript team's own published benchmarks (12.8s -> 1.47s). Its generated/ sources come from a build step that isn't run here, so both compilers report the same 12 missing-module errors.
